verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH/terminal client whose documented features cover host management, vaults, snippets, port forwarding, SFTP and a mobile terminal. Pull-request review is a code-hosting or code-review capability outside this product category, so the story is a wrong-axis question. Nothing in the evidence shows Termius ships any PR-review feature; running git tools over SSH from a phone would only be a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review pull requests from my phone while on the go
